author: Good Enough
description:
20,000 people witnessed one of the most famous UFO sightings in history when mysterious lights appeared over Arizona during the Phoenix Lights incident. This Short explores what thousands of eyewitnesses reported seeing, why the event became one of the largest mass UFO sightings ever recorded, and why it remains one of the most debated UAP cases to this day.

Discover what happened over Arizona, why so many people witnessed the same unexplained phenomenon, and why the Phoenix Lights continue to fascinate witnesses, investigators, and UFO enthusiasts decades later.
